question.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=5u+3,\,y=7v-u
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & 0 \\ b & 7\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}c \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

First, notice that we can express the given transformation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5u+3 \\ 7v-u\end{aligned}].
$$

Separating the constants and expressing the linear part as a product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5u+3 \\ 7v-u\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5u \\ -u+7v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ -1 & 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=5+(-1)+3=7.
$$
